macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks face mixed open as inflation and AI volatility weigh
items.summary: U.S. futures were mixed Friday, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq heading toward weekly losses after technology and AI-related stocks came under pressure. Thursday’s trading ended with the Dow up 1.1%, the S&P 500 up 0.3% and the Nasdaq up 0.1%.[1][6]

items.title: Fed Chair Warsh avoids signaling October or December rate decision
items.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh declined to prejudge upcoming meetings after recent hotter-than-expected inflation data. Markets priced a 15% chance of an October rate hike, down from 28% the prior day, while the implied probability of a December hike remained 89%.[1][2]

items.title: U.S. producer inflation reaches highest level since 2022
items.summary: The producer price index rose 6.3% year over year in September, accelerating from 5.6% in August and marking its largest increase since December 2022. The data heightened concern that persistent inflation could keep the Federal Reserve on a tighter policy path.[6][7]

items.title: Tesla shares rise after Roadster reveal
items.summary: Tesla shares gained about 5% in premarket trading after the company unveiled its new all-electric Roadster, providing a notable boost amid broader weakness in technology stocks.[1][2]

items.title: AI financing concerns continue to pressure CoreWeave
items.summary: CoreWeave shares fell more than 4% in premarket trading, extending a volatile week driven by investor concerns about the Nvidia-backed cloud company’s debt. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defended CoreWeave’s financial strength, helping ease some semiconductor-sector selling pressure.[1][5]

items.title: Indonesia stocks plunge after MSCI status warning
items.summary: Indonesia’s stock market fell sharply after MSCI warned that it could downgrade the country from emerging-market status, adding to broader volatility in Asian equities following a technology-led sell-off.[6]

items.title: Oil prices remain elevated as markets weigh Middle East risks
items.summary: U.S. crude traded near $97.55 a barrel and Brent near $105.75, with prices slightly lower on the day as traders balanced geopolitical risks against efforts to increase supply.[1]

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $82,000 after brief drop below $80,000
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered after a sharp move below $80,000, while the broader crypto market rose about 1% to $2.86 trillion. Ethereum, Solana and XRP also posted modest 24-hour gains, though major assets remained lower over the week.[1]

items.title: Crypto liquidations approach $1 billion as leveraged positions unwind
items.summary: Approximately $932 million in crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours, including about $796 million in long positions. Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds reportedly recorded substantial net outflows during the same period.[1]

items.title: NEAR rises 10% after protocol and ecosystem announcements
items.summary: NEAR traded around $5.21, up roughly 10% in 24 hours, following announcements including the launch of a 17-operator multiparty-computation network, AI infrastructure developments and expanded ecosystem ties.[2]

items.title: EBA classifies USDC as the EU’s first significant e-money token under MiCA
items.summary: The European Banking Authority designated Circle’s USDC as the EU’s first significant e-money token under the Markets in Crypto-Assets framework. Direct EBA supervision of key aspects of USDC’s operations is scheduled to begin November 12.[3]

items.title: White House crypto adviser Patrick Witt exits as legislation stalls
items.summary: Patrick Witt reportedly left his role as White House chief crypto adviser while proposed U.S. crypto-market legislation, including the Clarity Act, remains stalled.[3]

items.title: Ledger announces Android-based Atom crypto device
items.summary: Ledger announced Ledger Atom, an Android-based device designed to support everyday applications alongside a dedicated crypto-security mode and AI assistant. The product is planned for release in mid-2027.[1]

items.title: Multiliquid developer raises $8 million
items.summary: Uniform Labs, developer of the Multiliquid project, raised $8 million across pre-seed and seed funding rounds, according to reporting summarized by The Block.[3]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Yeat joins Fortnite Icon Series
items.summary: Epic Games announced rapper Yeat as the next artist featured in Fortnite’s Icon Series, bringing new themed content to the game.

items.title: New games released across major platforms
items.summary: Recent releases include Valor Mortis, Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse, Gears of War: E-Day and Forever Ago, spanning PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Switch and PC.

items.title: CD Projekt Red advances original IP Project Hadar
items.summary: CD Projekt Red reportedly completed the worldbuilding phase for Project Hadar, its first original intellectual property, and has moved the project into development.

items.title: Xsolla opens GDC 2027 scholarship applications
items.summary: Xsolla launched a scholarship program intended to help 75 independent developers attend the 2027 Game Developers Conference by offsetting travel and attendance costs.

items.title: World of Warcraft patch preview and raid progression
items.summary: Blizzard previewed World of Warcraft patch 12.1.7, Echoes of the Worldcore, while Team Liquid defeated Mythic Kith’ix in ongoing raid progression.

items.title: Gundam Rogue Orbit gets March 2027 release date
items.summary: Bandai Namco released a new trailer for Gundam Rogue Orbit and announced a March 5, 2027 release date for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and PC.
